origin.note: An auth-class case, so the set covers the plan-required auth path; the gap mirrors the access lines the walk PM added.

title: A document in another library is not reachable by id
objective: Close an access gap in the API: GET /api/documents/:id returns another library's document to anyone signed in. A document is reachable only by members of its library. For anyone else, GET /api/documents/:id, GET and POST /api/documents/:id/links answer exactly like a missing document: 404 { error: 'not_found' }, with no title in the body. Signed-out calls stay 401.
acceptance: A member of another library gets 404 not_found for d1, exactly like a missing id
Links of d1 are not listed or created by a non-member
Members still read the document and its links
plan_summary: Use store.canSee in the document routes of api.mjs.
